question: For July 2026, show net revenue by sales region and exclude refunded orders.

selected.text: Net revenue equals gross_amount minus discount_amount minus refund_amount.
An order is refunded when order_status_code = 40; exclude these rows for the requested report.
Sales region is dim_region.region_name joined through orders.region_id = dim_region.region_id.
